assets.evidence: Bundled the reference Earth dark texture, topology texture, and country outlines locally; retained the original Google Fonts stylesheet link. Header wordmark is text, so no separate icon/logo asset is used.

measure.evidence: Measurement is unavailable in this environment: pingfusi capture-run repeatedly refused the loaded reference at 14 rAF Hz, including after the prescribed headful retry; the browser fallback requires JavaScript injection, while the available CUA interface provides screenshots and accessibility snapshots only.

build.evidence: The Vite React clone is built and copied to targets/field-atlas/clone, but Pingfusi could not produce clone.json: capture-run refused the local canvas at 6–8 rAF Hz in both headless and prescribed headful modes.

visual.evidence: Pixel comparison requires live.json and clone.json; the live-page probe refused three times at 14 rAF Hz and the clone-only probe refused at 6–8 rAF Hz, so no matched measurements exist.

coverage.evidence: Painted-leaf coverage requires the live and clone DOM captures; both capture runners refused their compositor probes, and the browser fallback cannot execute injected scripts through the available CUA interface.

strict.evidence: Strict structural comparison requires the refused live/clone measurement artifacts; no comparable snapshots were produced.

behavior.evidence: Behavior capture requires a foreground measurement compositor on both pages; capture-run refused the live page and local WebGL clone after repeated probes, and the available browser interface only exposes read-only DOM/AX and screenshots.
